content.title: Minnesota Timberwolves vs. Oklahoma City Thunder: How To Watch, Live Stream & Game Preview
content.text: The eyes of the basketball world turn to the Paycom Center this afternoon for a premier Western Conference matinee as Anthony Edwards and the Minnesota Timberwolves challenge Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and the first-place Oklahoma City Thunder. The Oklahoma City Thunder (52-15) enter today’s contest on a blistering seven-game winning streak, currently holding a three-game lead for the No. 1 seed in the West. OKC is led by MVP frontrunner Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, who is second in the NBA in scoring at 31.8 points per game. The Thunder’s elite defense, which allows a league-low 107.8 points per game, is anchored by Chet Holmgren (17.2 PPG, 1.9 BPG) and defensive specialist Luguentz Dort. The Minnesota Timberwolves (41-26), meanwhile, are fighting to secure a top-four seed and avoid the Play-In tournament. Minnesota is led by Anthony Edwards (29.7 PPG), though he is currently listed as questionable with knee soreness. The Wolves will rely on the interior dominance of Rudy Gobert (11.3 RPG) and the scoring of Julius Randle to combat OKC’s depth. Having won two of the three previous meetings this season, Minnesota looks to prove they remain the Thunder’s biggest threat in the West. How to watch Timberwolves vs Thunder Today's marquee matchup will be broadcast nationally on ABC, with local radio coverage also available in both markets.
